scope: Generic 20-session breakout opportunities not selected by the frozen VCP detector.

outcomes.leader: 40-session MFE at least 50 percent; 100 percent paths are reported separately
outcomes.failed_control: 40-session MFE below 10 percent and 40-session equal-weight Alpha no greater than zero

causal_applicability_regimes.broad_bull: Signal-day MA20 breadth at least 70 percent and trailing 63-session SH/SZ equal-weight return nonnegative.
causal_applicability_regimes.weak_bear: Signal-day MA20 breadth below 30 percent and trailing 63-session SH/SZ equal-weight return negative.

matching: Compare leaders with all failed controls inside the same signal year and causal signal-time market regime. Future 40-session market outcomes are reported only for attribution and never define applicability. Control category shares use fixed Laplace smoothing of one count per registered category.

causal_categories.contracting_shelf: Prior 10-session range is smaller than the preceding 10-session range, its low is higher, and prior 10-session mean volume is below the preceding 30-session mean.
causal_categories.contraction_without_dry_up: Range contracts and the low rises, but volume does not dry up.
causal_categories.volume_dry_base: Volume dries up without both price-contraction conditions.
causal_categories.ascending_base: The recent low rises without range contraction or volume dry-up.
causal_categories.range_compression_only: Range contracts without a higher low or volume dry-up.
causal_categories.loose_breakout: None of the registered contraction categories applies; report only and never promote.

success_semantics: A category may pass across all market states or only inside one preregistered causal applicability regime. A regime-specific pass is a successful conditional strategy hypothesis, not a weaker failure label.
stop_rule: At most one non-loose category may be selected. If none passes every gate, stop this representation. Do not change windows, market-state boundaries, leader/control labels or combine categories after reading results.
